presentationHooks: Declare optional partial void BuildMayhemMarina(); partial void UpdateMayhemMarina(); partial void DisposeMayhemMarina(); partial void MarinaInteractionRange(ref float distance);
Call BuildMayhemMarina() at end of Build(), after BuildWardrobe().
Call UpdateMayhemMarina() at start of Update() after lobby/player validity guard, before UpdateWardrobe().
Call DisposeMayhemMarina() at beginning of OnDestroy(), before DisposeWardrobe().
In Point(): float distance=4; MarinaInteractionRange(ref distance); use current distance instead of literal4 in collider.Raycast.

In Point() foreach: skip only choices whose parent hierarchy is inactive (not the button itself; button visibility must remain reevaluable). E.g if(!choice.button || !choice.button.transform.parent.gameObject.activeInHierarchy)continue;
wardrobeHooks: Remove readonly from wardrobeCenter; keep original default. New scoped partial adapter will relocate field/pod/panel after original BuildWardrobe and reuse existing orbit customizer.
sessionHooks: Declare fields with current defaults: Vector3 lobbyLayoutCenter=Vector3.zero,lobbyLayoutSpawn=new Vector3(0,.5f,-3.5f); float lobbyLayoutTop=.45f,lobbyLayoutRadius=9,lobbyLayoutReturnDistance=30; Bounds lobbyLayoutBounds=new Bounds(Vector3.up*2,new Vector3(18,4,18));
Declare optional partial void ConfigureMayhemMarinaLobby(); static partial void MayhemMarinaSpawn(int slot,ref Vector3 point);
Update fall/boundary guard uses lobbyLayoutReturnDistance*lobbyLayoutReturnDistance instead of900; fall threshold can stay-.9f.
SpawnPoint(int slot): preserve old calculation in a local point, call MayhemMarinaSpawn(slot,ref point), return point. Default behavior stays unchanged without new partial.
controlsHooks: Track all Collider() created GameObjects in owned list; parent them under IslandLobby transform with world pose preserved for cleanup.

SetFloor() replaces all prior tracked floor/blocker copies before constructing new floor. This allows new presentation layout to replace old floor+cabinet positions instead of leaving invisible collision across inlet.

Declare optional partial void MayhemMarinaFloor(GameObject floor,Mesh mesh,Transform pose); call it after assigning new floor MeshCollider. New scoped session partial adds Core IClimbable marker and appropriate surface layer.
No Core additions, packages, scene saves, or UI redesign in these hooks. All appearance/layout logic stays in new scoped Marina folders.
